content.title: About
content.content: Pork and beef sausage (993) is a traditional meat product made by blending ground pork and beef, seasoning with spices, and then cooking or smoking. It offers a rich meaty flavor, aromatic spices, and a firm yet tender texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The combination of pork and beef provides a balanced flavor and texture profile.
Classic recipes include garlic, black pepper, nutmeg, and paprika.
Smoked versions have a longer shelf life due to the smoking process.
In some Russian regions the sausage is made “home‑style” without artificial preservatives.
It can be produced as boiled or semi‑smoked, depending on the manufacturing method.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Pork and beef supply high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Beef is especially high in heme iron, which is readily absorbed by the body.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The sausage provides vitamin B12, niacin, and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Zinc and selenium
items.content: These minerals support immune function and antioxidant protection.

items.title: Energy dense
items.content: Its high caloric content makes it a good source of energy when consumed in moderation.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Sausage often contains a significant amount of salt, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Saturated fats
items.content: Saturated fat levels can contribute to elevated cholesterol if eaten excessively.

items.title: Preservatives and nitrites
items.content: Some varieties contain nitrites, which in large amounts are considered potentially harmful.

items.title: Spice allergy
items.content: Spices used in the recipe may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sausage can be enjoyed cold as a snack, sliced for sandwiches, added to salads or soups, or pan‑fried. Lightly searing it before serving enhances its flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the sausage in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in its original packaging or an airtight container. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. It can be frozen for up to 2 months if vacuum‑packed.
